terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.content:
## 1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing or using VolleySmart (the "Service"), operated by dieBrudie ("we", "us", or "our"), you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the Service.

## 2. Description of Service

VolleySmart is a volleyball team management platform that enables users to:

- Create and manage volleyball clubs
- Schedule events and track attendance (RSVP)
- Generate balanced teams based on player skill and position
- Track game scores, sets, and match statistics
- View personal and club analytics
- Discover public events and clubs

## 3. Account Registration & Eligibility

You must be at least 16 years old to create an account. You may register using your email address or through a third-party authentication provider (Google or Apple). You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities under your account.

## 4. User Responsibilities

You agree to:

- Provide accurate and complete information during registration and profile setup
- Not impersonate another person or misrepresent your affiliation with any entity
- Not use the Service for any unlawful purpose or in violation of these Terms
- Not attempt to gain unauthorized access to any part of the Service
- Treat other users with respect

## 5. Intellectual Property

All content, design, and code of the Service are owned by dieBrudie and protected by intellectual property laws. You may not copy, modify, distribute, or reverse-engineer any part of the Service without our written consent.

## 6. User-Generated Content

You retain ownership of the content you submit (profile information, club descriptions, event details, game data). By submitting content, you grant us a non-exclusive, worldwide license to use, store, and display that content solely for the purpose of operating the Service.

You are responsible for ensuring that your content does not violate any third-party rights or applicable laws.

## 7. Third-Party Services

The Service integrates with third-party providers to deliver its functionality:

- **Supabase**: Database hosting, user authentication, and file storage
- **Mapbox**: Location autocomplete for event venues
- **Resend**: Email delivery for notifications and invitations
- **Google / Apple**: OAuth authentication
- **Cloudflare**: Web hosting and content delivery

Your use of these third-party services is subject to their respective terms and privacy policies.

## 8. Termination & Account Deletion

You may delete your account at any time from within the app. Upon deletion, your personal data will be removed in accordance with our Privacy Policy. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms.

If you are the sole administrator of a club with other active members, you must transfer admin rights or remove members before deleting your account.

## 9. Disclaimers

The Service is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied. We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation of the Service.

We are not responsible for:

- The accuracy of user-generated content
- Any injuries or incidents occurring during volleyball activities organized through the Service
- Loss of data beyond our reasonable control

## 10. Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, dieBrudie shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of the Service.

## 11. Governing Law

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany. Any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in Berlin, Germany.

## 12. Changes to These Terms

We may update these Terms from time to time. If we make material changes, we will notify you through the Service or by email. Your continued use of the Service after such changes constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.

## 13. Contact

If you have questions about these Terms, please contact us at:

**Email**: hello@volleysmart.app
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
## 1. Introduction

This Privacy Policy explains how dieBrudie ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you use VolleySmart (the "Service"). We are committed to protecting your privacy in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other applicable data protection laws.

**Data Controller**: dieBrudie
**Contact**: hello@volleysmart.app

## 2. Data We Collect

### Account & Authentication Data
- Email address
- Password (hashed and encrypted — we never store plain-text passwords)
- Authentication provider data (if you sign in via Google or Apple)

### Profile Information
- First name and last name
- Birthday
- Gender
- Height
- City and country
- Profile photo
- Bio / description
- Volleyball positions (e.g., Setter, Libero)
- Skill rating (calculated from onboarding input and gameplay)

### Club & Membership Data
- Club name, description, and image
- Club location (city, country)
- Membership role (admin, editor, member)
- Join requests and membership status history

### Event & Attendance Data
- Events you create or attend
- RSVP status (attending, declined)
- Event details (date, time, location, description)

### Game & Performance Data
- Match scores and set results
- Team assignments and player positions per game
- Win/loss statistics and analytics
- Hours played

### Notification Data
- In-app notification history
- Notification preferences (per notification type)

### Images
- Profile photos and club images uploaded to the Service

### Location Data
- City and country entered in your profile
- Event venue names and addresses
- Location search queries sent to Mapbox for autocomplete (your approximate location via IP address may be used by Mapbox to rank search results)

### Technical Data
- Language preference (stored locally in your browser)
- Theme preference (light/dark mode)

## 3. How We Use Your Data

We use your data to:

- Provide and operate the Service (account management, club features, event scheduling, game tracking)
- Generate balanced teams based on player skill and position
- Calculate and display personal and club statistics
- Send in-app notifications about club activity, events, and games
- Send emails for account verification, password resets, club invitations, and join request notifications
- Improve the Service based on aggregated, anonymized usage patterns

## 4. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR)

- **Contract Performance** (Art. 6(1)(b)): Processing necessary to provide you the Service you signed up for
- **Consent** (Art. 6(1)(a)): For optional features like email notifications, which you can control via notification preferences
- **Legitimate Interest** (Art. 6(1)(f)): For Service improvement and security

## 5. Data Sharing & Third Parties

We share data with third-party service providers only as necessary to operate the Service:

| Provider | Purpose | Data Shared |
|---|---|---|
| **Supabase** | Database, authentication, file storage | All user data (encrypted at rest and in transit) |
| **Resend** | Email delivery | Email addresses, user names, club names |
| **Mapbox** | Location autocomplete | Search queries, browser language, IP-based proximity |
| **Google** | OAuth authentication | Email, name (as authorized by you) |
| **Apple** | OAuth authentication | Email, name (as authorized by you) |
| **Cloudflare** | Web hosting and CDN | Standard web request data |

We do not sell your personal data. We do not share your data with advertisers or data brokers.

## 6. Data Storage & Security

- Your data is stored on Supabase infrastructure
- Passwords are hashed using industry-standard algorithms by Supabase Auth
- All data transmission uses HTTPS/TLS encryption
- Database access is protected by Row Level Security (RLS) — users can only access data they are authorized to view
- Images are stored in Supabase Storage with access controls

## 7. Data Retention

- Your data is retained for as long as your account is active
- When you delete your account, your personal data is removed. Some anonymized, aggregated data (e.g., game statistics) may be retained
- Club data you created (events, games) may persist in anonymized form for other club members

## 8. Your Rights (GDPR)

Under the GDPR, you have the right to:

- **Access**: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you
- **Rectification**: Correct inaccurate or incomplete data (you can do this directly in your profile)
- **Erasure**: Request deletion of your data (available via the "Delete my account" feature in the app)
- **Restriction**: Request that we limit the processing of your data
- **Portability**: Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
- **Objection**: Object to data processing based on legitimate interest
- **Withdraw Consent**: Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw it at any time via notification preferences

To exercise these rights, contact us at **hello@volleysmart.app**.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority, in particular in the EU member state of your habitual residence.

## 9. Children's Privacy

The Service is not intended for children under 16 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 16. If we learn that we have collected data from a child under 16, we will promptly delete it.

## 10. Cookies & Local Storage

VolleySmart does not use tracking cookies or third-party analytics cookies. We use browser local storage solely for:

- **Authentication session**: Managed by Supabase (session token for keeping you logged in)
- **Language preference**: Your chosen display language
- **Theme preference**: Light or dark mode setting

No data is shared with advertisers or third-party trackers through these mechanisms.

## 11. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will notify you through the Service or by email. The "Last updated" date at the top indicates the most recent revision.

## 12. Contact

For questions about this Privacy Policy or to exercise your data rights, contact us at:

**Email**: hello@volleysmart.app
